content: Living things are organisms that grow, reproduce, respond to their environment, and require food and energy. Examples of living things include plants, animals, and humans. Non-living things do not grow, reproduce, or respond to stimuli. Examples of non-living things include rocks, water, and air. The key difference between living and non-living things is that living things carry out life processes.
